name: Accounting & Bookkeeping
heading: Know what your numbers are telling you.
description: Organise sales, purchases, expenses and bank transactions into accounts you can use. Capital Mind Associates helps Delhi businesses understand profit, outstanding payments and cash movement.
scope: Bookkeeping & ledgers
Record transactions under the correct accounts, supported by invoices and vouchers. A ledger brings all entries for one account together.
Bank reconciliation
Compare bank statements with your books. Identify missing entries, bank charges and payments that need clarification.
Financial reporting
Prepare a balance sheet, profit and loss statement and cash-flow summary. A balance sheet shows assets, liabilities and owners’ funds at a point in time.
Payroll & management reports
Organise salary inputs, payslips, receivables, payables and monthly MIS reports. MIS means management information: useful summaries for business decisions.
docs: Sales and purchase invoices
Bank statements and opening balances
Expense vouchers and loan statements
Payroll inputs and existing accounting backup
faq: Does bookkeeping include tax filing?
Bookkeeping records business transactions. GST, TDS and income-tax returns are separate tasks; we agree which services your engagement includes.
What reports can I receive?
Depending on the agreed scope, you can receive a trial balance, profit and loss statement, balance sheet, debtor and creditor ageing, and cash-flow summaries.
Can you help with pending accounts?
Yes. Start with the period to be updated, available records and existing software backup. We first identify missing information and agree the work required.

name: GST Registration & Returns
heading: Bring your invoices, returns and credits into line.
sub: GST support that starts with your records.
description: Get support with GST registration, return preparation, input tax credit reconciliation and notice documentation. We explain the information needed and review mismatches before submission.
scope: Registration & amendments
Review your business activity and registration requirements. Prepare application details and supporting documents; support changes in existing registration particulars.
GSTR-1, GSTR-3B & annual returns
Organise outward-supply details for GSTR-1 and summary tax information for GSTR-3B. Review GSTR-9 annual-return requirements for the relevant year.
ITC reconciliation

Match purchase records with GSTR-2B and investigate missing or different invoice details. Input tax credit eligibility needs separate review; an invoice appearing in a statement is not the only condition.
GST notice assistance
Read the issue, period and response requirement. Reconcile relevant records and prepare supporting explanations for review and authorised submission.
docs: PAN and business constitution records
Business-address and authorised-signatory documents
Sales, purchase and credit/debit-note data
Previous returns, GSTR-2B and any notice received
faq: What is the difference between GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B?
GSTR-1 reports outward supplies such as sales. GSTR-3B summarises tax liability and input tax credit for a tax period.
Why reconcile GST records?
Comparing books, return data and supplier information helps find omitted invoices, duplicates and mismatches before they become larger reporting problems.
Is GST registration approval guaranteed?
No. Approval rests with the department. Accurate documents and a complete application help the review process, but additional queries may be raised.

name: ITR Filing & Tax Advisory
heading: A clearer picture of your income and tax.
description: Prepare your income-tax return with an organised view of salary, business income, investments and tax already paid. We review documents, identify information gaps and explain the computation before filing.
scope: Individual ITR preparation
Bring together salary, interest, rental income, investment transactions and other income. The applicable return depends on your facts.
Business & professional income
Connect your accounts with the income-tax computation. Review reported income, expenses, depreciation and relevant supporting schedules.
Tax computation & planning
Compare available treatment where applicable, review evidence for claims and explain estimated tax. Tax planning must reflect actual transactions and eligibility.
TDS review & return support
Reconcile tax deducted at source with available records. Support TDS statement preparation and correction work under a separately agreed scope.
docs: PAN and relevant identity details
Form 16, AIS, tax-credit records and challans
Bank interest and investment transaction statements
Books of account and supporting claim documents
faq: Can you file returns for salaried and business taxpayers?
The service covers preparation support for different income profiles. We identify the suitable return and required schedules after reviewing your income sources.
What is TDS?
Tax deducted at source is tax withheld by a payer on certain payments. It needs to be checked against the income and tax-credit records used for your return.
Will I definitely receive a refund?
No. A refund depends on your final tax liability, tax paid and departmental processing. We do not promise a refund amount or processing date.

name: Company & LLP Registration
heading: Give your business the right foundation.
sub: From business structure to organised records.
description: Understand the difference between a company and a limited liability partnership before you apply. We help organise incorporation information, supporting documents and the next compliance steps.
scope: Business structure review
Discuss ownership, management, funding and recurring compliance before choosing a structure. Incorporation is a business decision as well as a filing task.
Company incorporation support
Organise proposed names, director details, registered-office records and business objects for the relevant application workflow.
LLP registration support
Prepare partner information and incorporation records. Explain the role of the LLP agreement and subsequent compliance obligations.
Udyam & DSC assistance
Help you understand MSME/Udyam registration and digital signature requirements where relevant. Government registration charges and professional assistance fees are explained separately.
docs: Proposed names and business activity
Identity and address records of directors or partners
Registered-office proof and owner consent where required
Ownership, contribution and authorised-signatory details
faq: Does a company name protect my trademark?
No. Company name approval and trademark registration are separate processes. A separate trademark review is useful before investing in branding.
Should I choose a company or an LLP?
The answer depends on ownership, investment plans, management preferences and compliance needs. We explain the differences using your business plans.
What happens after registration?
Maintain records, set up the required operational registrations and understand annual and event-based filings. Our ROC compliance page explains the follow-up work.

name: ROC Filing & Annual Compliance
heading: Keep company records ready for the next filing.
description: Organise company or LLP records and track the filings relevant to your business. Capital Mind Associates helps connect financial information, statutory records and filing documentation.
scope: Company annual filing support
Prepare supporting information for applicable annual returns and financial-statement filings. Requirements depend on the company and reporting period.
LLP annual compliance
Organise annual-return and account-related information. LLP Form 11 is an annual return; other requirements are reviewed separately.
Director & event-based records
Review the documentation required for applicable director KYC, appointment, registered-office or other corporate changes.
Pending filing review
Check available filing acknowledgements, identify gaps and agree a corrective workflow. Additional fees or legal consequences require case-specific review.
docs: CIN or LLPIN and incorporation records
Prior filings and acknowledgements
Financial statements and statutory records
Details of directors, partners and corporate changes
faq: Is ROC filing the same as an income-tax return?
No. ROC filings relate to corporate reporting with the Registrar of Companies. Income-tax returns report taxable income to the tax department.
Does an inactive business still need a review?
Yes. Lack of business activity does not automatically remove filing obligations. The entity’s status and applicable rules must be checked.
Can you check older pending filings?
We can review the available records and filing history to identify the work required. Fees, consequences and available remedies depend on the case.

name: Trademark Registration
heading: Build a brand with protection in mind.
sub: Your business name deserves a careful review.
description: Get assistance with trademark search, class selection, application information and status tracking. We explain the stages so you understand what filing an application does—and what it does not do.
scope: Search & class selection
Review similar marks and the goods or services you provide. Classification helps define the scope of the application; a search does not guarantee acceptance.
Application preparation
Organise owner details, mark representation and supporting information for the application. Government fees and assistance fees are separate.
Status & objection support
Track application progress and help organise a response to examination issues. Representation or specialist legal work is confirmed separately where needed.
Renewal & brand records
Maintain application and registration details and review renewal needs. Company registration and domain ownership do not replace trademark protection.
docs: Applicant identity and business constitution
Wordmark or logo and goods/services description
Use details and evidence, where applicable
Authorisation and existing application details, if any
faq: Is trademark registration guaranteed?
No. The Registry examines the application and third-party opposition may arise. Filing is the beginning of the process, not a registration certificate.
Can I apply for a name or a logo?
A wordmark and a logo can involve different protection considerations. Discuss how you use the brand before choosing what to apply for.
How long does protection last?
Trademark registration can be renewed for further ten-year periods under the applicable process. Track the specific registration and renewal requirements.

name: Business Loans & Financial Reports
heading: Present your business finances with clarity.
sub: Better financial preparation for funding discussions.
description: Bring your bank statements, financial accounts and funding purpose together. We support loan-document preparation, working-capital analysis, CMA data and project reports without promising lender approval.
scope: Business & working-capital finance
Prepare information for business loans, overdraft, cash credit and machinery funding. Match the funding need with the operating cycle and repayment capacity.
Property & other loan documentation
Discuss document assistance for loans against property, home, personal, vehicle or education loans. Product availability and terms depend on the lender.
CMA data & projections
Credit Monitoring Arrangement data presents financial information for lending assessment. Projections explain future estimates and the assumptions behind them.
Project reports & bank analysis
Describe the project, estimated cost, funding mix and expected cash flows. Review bank credits, debits, average balances and existing repayment commitments.
docs: Financial statements, ITRs and GST data
Bank statements and existing loan schedules
Business KYC and ownership records
Project cost, funding purpose and property details where relevant
faq: Do you directly approve or disburse loans?
No. Lenders decide approval, security, rates and disbursement. Our role is financial preparation and agreed application-document assistance.
What does working capital mean?
Working capital funds the everyday operating cycle: inventory, customer credit and routine expenses before cash is collected.
What is the difference between a project report and CMA data?
A project report explains a proposed activity and its economics. CMA data organises historical and projected financial information for credit review.
